## Goal
Prove with real AWS that tenant A can never read tenant B, through any path.

## Owns
- `tests/e2e/isolation/**`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- Token A against every tool route with B ids in body/path -> no B data.
- Direct AssumeRole with tag A -> DynamoDB query on TENANT#B denied.
- AppSync subscribe cross-tenant denied.
